review:
A 7x7 cluster game inspired by Pop It fidget toys, with refills, match-3 elements, big symbols and backlit symbols.

A 100-point progress bar sits under the reels: every win knocks off a point, every 25 points fires a random feature, and when it hits zero, three waves of wilds crash onto the reels. It gives you a long-term goal, and makes the base game the main event. Very high volatility, 12,000x max and 96.3% RTP. Free spins about once every 380 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
